trust_decision.summary: An application-supplied parameter number (SQLUSMALLINT) is accepted as a binding count stored in SQLSMALLINT APD/IPD/put-data 'allocated' fields; the range check 1..SHRT_MAX lives in PGAPI_BindParameter and is ALREADY present at the pinned commit.

landing_point.why: Summary names SQLBindParameter and the 32767 limit; PGAPI_BindParameter is the first stop, and the guard is already there at the pinned commit.

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: pgapi30.c:760-762 (APD SQL_DESC_COUNT) and pgapi30.c:921-922 (IPD SQL_DESC_COUNT) via PGAPI_SetDescField pgapi30.c:2112,2120

O3_reason_to_dismiss: SQLSetDescField(SQL_DESC_COUNT) is a descriptor API rather than SQLBindParameter, and the driver manager (unixODBC) is expected to reject negative counts before the driver sees them.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Exactly 32767 bound parameters must still bind and execute, and SQL_DESC_COUNT=0 must still free/unbind all parameters; a guard using < instead of <= or rejecting 0 breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: parameter number 32768..65535 wrapping a SQLSMALLINT count (bind.c:66)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: SQLSetDescField(APD, SQL_DESC_COUNT, negative) sets apdopts->allocated negative without freeing; the next bind extends with a memset starting at a negative index.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Descriptor API, not SQLBindParameter; driver manager may pre-validate the count.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file (pgapi30.c) from landing point bind.c; sink at bind.c:543

O8_uncovered_routes.route: SQLSetDescField(IPD, SQL_DESC_COUNT, negative) sets ipdopts->allocated negative; the next extend_iparameter_bindings memsets from a negative index.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: IPD is the implementation descriptor; a solver may treat it as read-mostly and outside the bind path.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: SQLBindCol with column number 32768..65535 wraps the SQLSMALLINT ARD/getdata 'allocated'; a later extend_getdata_info copies with a size_t index bounded by the negative count.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Column binding, not parameter binding; the advisory only names SQLBindParameter and parameters.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, different function; sink bind.c:922-927

O8b_injection_room.sibling: parameter_bindings_set accepts any int count, including negative, and stores it in SQLSMALLINT allocated.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The helper is shared by SQL_DESC_COUNT and the per-record path; a maintainer guarding only the public bind call would naturally leave it alone.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: column_bindings_set gets the same negative/oversized count from ARD SQL_DESC_COUNT.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: ARD mirrors APD (descriptor.h:134-136 says APD must match ARD), so the bug pattern is shared.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: extend_putdata_info memsets from &pdata[allocated] with a SQLSMALLINT allocated.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is the same realloc+memset-from-old-count idiom as extend_parameter_bindings.

O9_family: integer overflow / signedness truncation (SQLUSMALLINT -> SQLSMALLINT count) leading to heap buffer underwrite (CWE-190, CWE-124)

O10_build.toolchain: autoconf/automake + gcc, libpq, unixODBC (driver manager) headers
services: PostgreSQL server for the regression suite
O10_build.project_tests: test/src/param-count-limit-test.c with test/expected/param-count-limit.out (registered at test/tests:70); test/src/many-params-test.c

j.j_sites_touched: none (fix diff changes configure.ac, docs/release.html, version.h only)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add 'ipar < 1 || ipar > SHRT_MAX' in PGAPI_BindParameter only, leaving descriptor SQL_DESC_COUNT and SQLBindCol unguarded.

out_of_scope_notes: SC_scanQueryAndCountParams writes the placeholder count into SQLSMALLINT *pcpar (bind.c:485) and stmt->num_params is Int2 (statement.h:258); counts above 32767 could wrap, not pursued.
